result.summary: The image depicts a high-density urban intersection with robust pedestrian infrastructure including wide sidewalks, high-visibility continental crosswalks, and dedicated pedestrian signals. However, the multi-lane roadway and high volume of foot traffic create significant exposure and potential for conflict at the crossing points.

hazards.name: Unprotected crossing distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross three lanes of traffic without a median or refuge island, increasing exposure time.

hazards.name: Corner crowding
hazards.description: High pedestrian volumes at the corner may cause overflow into the roadway while waiting for signals.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and increase pedestrian visibility.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Adjust signal timing to provide pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before vehicles receive a green light.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised island in the center of the roadway to allow pedestrians to cross in two stages.
